transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID including its version suffix, for example ENSMUST00000192972.2. The _key of this record is the same ID with the version removed.

transcript_type.description: Biotype GENCODE assigns to the transcript, such as protein_coding, lncRNA, or retained_intron.

chr.description: Chromosome the transcript lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names such as chr8_KZ208915v1_fix.

start.description: Start of the transcript, 0-based and inclusive.

end.description: End of the transcript, 0-based and exclusive.

strand.description: Strand the transcript is transcribed from: '+' for the forward strand, '-' for the reverse strand.

gene_name.description: GENCODE symbol of the gene this transcript belongs to, for example Gm13290.

version.description: GENCODE release the annotation was taken from.

accessible_via.return: _id, chr, start, end, strand, gene_name, transcript_id, name, transcript_type, source, version, source_url, organism
